title: 第491章 玄道宗叶南山第490章 青锋才是主角
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：仙眼第一卷：风起九州第491章玄道宗叶南山（..la）“哼！阁下好狂的口气。”此道袍老者却不像那魁梧中年一般软弱，听到叶青锋的话，丝毫没有惧怕的意思。
他朝颜童子看了一眼，“老夫承认，不是你们三人的对手！但我敢保证，你们杀了老夫，也休想见到明天的太阳！”
“呵呵，哈哈，哈哈哈哈！”叶青锋大笑了起来。
“老东西，你真是不知天高地厚！你可知道本公子是谁。”
“哼，你是谁？”
“你听好了，本座叶青锋，自碧浪岛来！你身为此方城主，当明白碧浪岛三个字代表着什么吧。”
“什么，碧浪岛叶家？”道袍老者神色一惊。
“没错！本公子正是来自叶家，我要见你们宗主，马上带我们过去，否则弄死你！”叶青锋冷声命令，语气狂傲至极。
听到此话，道袍老者脸色一阵难看，但也拗不过对方身份。
“好，既是叶家之人，老夫自然不敢得罪！几位请跟我来吧。”
他胸膛起伏了几下，强忍着心中不快，转身朝外面走去。
韩林暗暗皱了皱眉头，迟疑了一下，才缓步跟在叶青锋的身后。
来到城主府广场，道袍老者让三人稍等，自己将那魁梧的中年喊到一边低声吩咐了几句，便祭出一把飞剑，准备带几人去玄道宗。
不过叶青锋却拿出一艘不大的三阶灵舟，让韩林三人一起站了上去。
随着灵舟启动，以惊人的速度划破苍穹，那道袍老者也不禁有些动容了，暗道：“看来此人并未说谎，真是来自碧空岛的贵公子。不过一看就是娇生惯养，平时没吃什么苦头，这样的性格早晚要被人弄死。”
想到此处，他偷偷朝韩林看了眼，“这家伙当真奇怪，六七年前据说才筑基初期，怎么一转眼就深不可测了，难道是施展了是什么隐藏修为的秘法不成？”
随即，又看了眼颜童子，“这位虽然长得又矮又挫，但实力绝对是金丹强者，真不愧是叶家公子，出个门竟有金丹强者贴身保护。”
最后，又瞥了眼韩林：“这家伙胆子当真不小，竟敢跟我前往玄道宗，难道就不怕，羊入虎口吗？”
“还是说，他跟这位叶家公子攀上关系，对方愿意保他？”
“若真是这样，搞不好宗主大人还真会改变某些决定……”

转瞬间，这位道袍老者的脑中，就闪过了数个念头。
“这位老哥，如何称呼？”这时，韩林忽然对着道袍老者抱了抱拳道。
“老道段思崖。”道袍老者迟疑了一下，十分敷衍地对韩林还了一礼。
“原来是段老，段老真不愧是玄道宗高人，这番不屈于人的风骨，在下佩服。”韩林笑着说道。
“什么狗屁风骨，简直不识时务！得亏本公子脾气好，要是遇到其他人，他早死了。”叶青锋冷笑道。
段思崖看了叶青锋一眼，心中对这个二世祖十分不爽，却不好发作。
韩林见状道：“段老，可否请问一下，如今九州关于我的通缉令还在吗，为何你一眼就将我认出来？”
段思崖淡淡道：“事情过去这么多年，通缉令的事情早就名存实亡了。
至于老夫能一眼认出你，自然是因为老夫肩负‘玄风城主’之责。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Immortal Eyes Volume 1: Wind Rises from Kyushu Chapter 491 Xuan Dao Sect Ye Nanshan (..la) "Humph! You have such a crazy tone." This old man in Taoist robes was not as weak as the burly middle-aged man. Hearing Ye Qingfeng's words, he showed no fear at all.
He glanced at Yan Tongzi, "I admit that I am no match for the three of you! But I can guarantee that if you kill me, you will never see the sun tomorrow!"
"Haha, haha, hahahaha!" Ye Qingfeng laughed.
"Old man, you really don't know the heights of the world! Do you know who I am?"
"Hmph, who are you?"
"Listen carefully, I, Ye Qingfeng, come from Bilang Island! As the lord of this city, you should understand what the three words Bilang Island mean."
"What, the Ye family of Bilang Island?" The old man in Taoist robes looked surprised.
"That's right! This young master is from the Ye family. I want to see your sect master. Take us there immediately, or we will kill you!" Ye Qingfeng ordered coldly, his tone extremely arrogant.
Hearing this, the old man in Taoist robes turned ugly for a while, but he couldn't resist the identity of the other party.
"Okay, since I am a member of the Ye family, I naturally dare not offend you! Please come with me."
His chest rose and fell a few times, and he suppressed his unhappiness, turned around and walked outside.
Han Lin frowned secretly and hesitated for a moment before slowly following behind Ye Qingfeng.
Arriving at the square of the City Lord's Mansion, the old man in Taoist robes asked the three of them to wait. He called the burly middle-aged man aside and whispered a few instructions, then took out a flying sword and prepared to take a few people to Xuan Dao Sect.
However, Ye Qingfeng took out a small third-level spirit boat and asked Han and Lin to stand on it.
As the spirit boat started up and cut through the sky at an alarming speed, the old man in Taoist robes couldn't help but feel a little moved. He said to himself: "It seems that this person is not lying. He is really a noble son from Blue Sky Island. But at first glance, he looks like a spoiled child who has never suffered much. Such a character will be killed sooner or later."
Thinking of this, he secretly glanced at Han Lin and said, "This guy is really strange. Six or seven years ago, it was said that he was in the early stages of foundation building. How could he become so unfathomable in the blink of an eye? Could it be that he used some secret method to hide his cultivation?"
Immediately, he glanced at Yan Tongzi again and said, "Although this person is short and stooped, he is definitely a strong man of the Golden Core. He is truly worthy of being the young master of the Ye family. He is protected by a strong man of the Golden Core when he goes out."
Finally, he glanced at Han Lin again: "This guy is really brave. He dares to follow me to Xuan Dao Sect. Aren't you afraid that the sheep will fall into the tiger's mouth?"
"Or is it that he has a relationship with this young master of the Ye family, and the other party is willing to protect him?"
"If this is the case, maybe the sect leader will really change some decisions..."
In an instant, several thoughts flashed through the mind of the old man in Taoist robes.
"How do you call this brother?" At this time, Han Lin suddenly hugged his fists towards the old man in Taoist robes.
"Old Taoist Duan Siya." The old man in Taoist robes hesitated for a moment and returned the salute to Han Lin perfunctorily.
"It turns out to be Mr. Duan. Mr. Duan is indeed a master of Xuan Dao Sect. I admire his unyielding character." Han Lin said with a smile.
"What a bullshit character, you simply don't understand the current affairs! I owe you my good temper. If he met anyone else, he would have died long ago." Ye Qingfeng sneered.
Duan Siya glanced at Ye Qingfeng and felt very unhappy with this second generation ancestor, but it was hard to get angry.
Han Lin saw this and said: "Mr. Duan, can I ask if there is still a wanted order for me in Kyushu? Why did you recognize me at a glance?"
Duan Siya said calmly: "After so many years, the wanted order has long existed in name only.
As for me being able to recognize you at a glance, it is naturally because I shoulder the responsibility of the ‘Lord of Xuanfeng City’.
